summary: CNMD is a -36.8% drawdown medical-devices name where the FORENSIC tape directly REJECTS any LONG thesis built on the 'portfolio optimization' narrative. The strongest finding is the asymmetric Form-4 tape: ZERO open-market code-P purchases by ANY insider in the trailing 12 months, while CFO Garner sold $150,500 discretionarily on Nov 6, 2025 (one day after Q3 earnings, with no 10b5-1 footnote) and was terminated 63 days later. The 'no disagreement' Item 5.02 boilerplate is contradicted by the temporal pattern. Director Martha Aronson — who was a 2024 open-market buyer at $70.98 — resigned July 7, 2025, removing one of the few historical bull signals from the board. The company is concurrently buying back stock at $41.55 average while the CFO personally sells: classic capital-allocation asymmetry. Operationally: 2025 net income collapsed 64% to $47.1M as SG&A jumped $113.7M ($64M contingent-consideration swing from Biorez, $12.2M former-CEO advisory, $12.9M operational consulting), capital products declined -2.1% in 2025 (negative leading indicator for 2026-27 single-use razor-blade revenue), Q1 2026 became the FIRST quarterly revenue decline (-1.3%), and the goodwill impairment test ($807M goodwill against thinning equity) is sensitive at current market cap. Mitigants are present (PwC 44-yr clean opinion, no going concern, $648M revolver availability, board refresh with Martin/Mirviss adding J&J MedTech experience to Audit + Strategy committees) but do not offset the insider tape. Verdict: SHORT-tier. Severity: 1 PASS / 0 UNVERIFIABLE / 5 MODERATE / 2 SEVERE / 0 RED_FLAG.
